Universal’s management held preliminary talks with private equity firms including Apollo Global

earlier this year, according to a Bloomberg report on Monday, which cited people familiar with the matter. The discussions haven’t progressed, nor has Universal started a sales process. The company’s board is aware of the conversations.
The PE shops and Universal declined to comment to Bloomberg.
Shares of Universal Music have fallen almost 30% this year.
The latest M&A news comes after Universal Music

proposal to merge with Pershing Square SPARC Holdings and pursue a New York Stock Exchange listing. Pershing Square, run by Bill Ackman, in April submitted a non-binding proposal to buy all outstanding shares of Universal Music Group N.V. (UMGNF), offering €9.4B in cash, or
and 0.77 shares of the new UMG stock per existing share.
